question: Does historically observable Latin America private-credit capital-supply announcement intensity predict next-month realized volatility, left-tail loss, or changes in rolling USD sensitivity in fixed LatAm/EM liquid-market proxy channels?

ideal_latent_variable.name: ex_ante_private_credit_capital_supply_available_to_latin_america_borrowers
ideal_latent_variable.unit: USD capital genuinely deployable to Latin America private-credit borrowers at each forecast origin
ideal_latent_variable.unobserved_problem: Private funds disclose closes and deployments sparsely; private loan tape, dry powder by mandate, and vintage histories are not public point-in-time panels.

primary_exposure_proxy.name: latam_private_credit_final_close_announcement_intensity
primary_exposure_proxy.exact_observable_construction: For each UTC calendar month, count unique final-close announcements for private-debt/private-credit funds whose stated mandate is dedicated to Latin America or allocates at least 50% to Latin America. Enumerate candidate funds from a complete, versioned Private Debt Investor fund database export; verify each retained row against the fund sponsor's official release. Deduplicate by legal fund name, vintage, and final-close date. Compute log1p(monthly unique final-close count). Rows with no verifiable release date are excluded; months are zero only when the complete enumeration frame proves no qualifying close, never because search returned no hits.

enumeration_source.name: Private Debt Investor fund database / fundraising records
enumeration_source.required_raw_identity: provider record id, export-as-of timestamp, export file SHA-256, fund legal name, vintage, strategy, geography mandate, close status, close amount if disclosed, and provider record creation/update timestamps
enumeration_source.required_access: authenticated record-level export with historical coverage and version/as-of metadata

point_in_time_verification_source.name: official sponsor final-close release
point_in_time_verification_source.required_raw_identity: canonical URL, publisher, HTTP response SHA-256, datePublished/timePublished metadata, access timestamp, fund legal name, close status, geography language, and amount when disclosed
point_in_time_verification_source.availability_rule: Use the official publication timestamp. If only a calendar date is available, the event becomes observable at 00:00 UTC on the following calendar day. A retrospective article date, fund vintage label, or close period is never substituted for publication availability.

primary_exposure_proxy.transformation: log1p(unique final-close announcements in month t), aligned to outcome month by an explicit pandas Series.shift(1)
known_measurement_error: announcement count is not committed USD volume, deployable dry powder, or actual loan origination
fund mandates can span regions and strategies even when marketing language emphasizes Latin America
undisclosed closes and manager publicity choices induce coverage bias
database backfills or revised tags break point-in-time validity unless a versioned export and record timestamps are retained
official releases can report final closes after capital was economically committed
prohibited_substitutions: generic private-credit news with no Latin America mandate
contemporaneous ETF, VIX, credit-spread, or USD variables that rename the outcome
2026 retrospective fundraising totals backfilled into earlier forecast origins
single-manager transaction archives treated as a complete regional universe

feasibility_gate.failure_action: Stop before requesting or loading any ETF outcome series and emit INCONCLUSIVE/INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Unknown coverage is not coded as zero events.

outcome_lock.data_source_if_feasible: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily closes fetched in one frozen snapshot; no forward fill
outcome_lock.ticker_inception_and_delisting_policy: Report first/last valid observation, missingness, duplicates, timezone, extreme returns, revisions, and common-sample loss for every ticker before estimation.
outcome_lock.forecast_origin: last trading close of calendar month t; only exposure events published by the monthly cutoff are eligible
outcome_lock.channel_return: equal-weight daily log return across members observed on the strict full-channel common date; no missing member is silently reweighted

targets.realized_variance: sum of squared daily channel log returns in outcome month
targets.left_tail_loss: max(0, negative of the minimum daily channel log return in outcome month)
targets.change_in_absolute_uup_beta: absolute 60-trading-day OLS beta of channel daily returns on UUP at outcome-month end minus its value at forecast-origin month end

outcome_lock.baseline: one-step monthly expanding AR(1) in the matching target; realized-variance target uses log realized variance
outcome_lock.candidate: same baseline and common estimation window plus the preregistered lagged exposure proxy
outcome_lock.lag_convention: Rows are indexed by outcome month; exposure is aligned with Series.shift(1). Baseline target lags use only information through the forecast origin.
outcome_lock.common_sample: Strict intersection of all nine fixed tickers after target construction and lagging; candidate and baseline use identical rows. Channel-only samples are secondary diagnostics and cannot replace the primary full-basket common sample.

primary_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down family-wise correction across all 9 primary candidate-vs-baseline tests
primary_family.dependence_robust_inference: Repository canonical QLIKE/DM for realized variance, with canonical bandwidth max(h-1, ceil(h^(1/3)*n^(1/3))) and reported lag sensitivity; HAC coefficient tests for tail loss and beta change, with loss/residual autocorrelation diagnostics
primary_family.seeded_sparse_event_path: seed=42 month-block permutation/bootstrap only if the proxy passes all feasibility thresholds

verdict_policy.SUPPORTED: Proxy passes feasibility and at least two channel cells within one prespecified target family have expected-sign effects with Holm-adjusted p<0.05; the matching robustness directions must not reverse.
verdict_policy.NULL: Proxy passes feasibility and the complete 9-cell primary family is estimated, but the SUPPORTED rule is not met. Secondary analyses cannot rescue the result.
verdict_policy.INCONCLUSIVE: Any proxy provenance, completeness, event-count, or common-sample feasibility requirement fails, so outcome analysis is not run.
verdict_policy.BLOCKED: Required provenance cannot be read or artifact identity cannot be established; no scientific claim is made.

secondary_robustness_only: alternative USD control or beta window
public transaction announcements distinct from final closes
